1	# Entire.io 会话附加与推送
2	
3	在完成作业后，检查 Entire 是否成功录制了当前会话。如果 SessionStart hook 没有正确触发（常见于 hooks 刚安装或重启后仍有问题），手动附加当前会话的转录文件并推送到 entire.io。
4	
5	> **配套 skill**：`/entire-setup` 负责初始化配置。本 skill 在配置完成后、正式干活时使用。
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 适用场景
10	
11	- 刚跑完 `/entire-setup`，关掉重开后在做作业
12	- 作业做完了，想确认 Entire 录到了对话
13	- 网页上看不到 checkpoint
14	
15	---
16	
17	## 流程
18	
19	### 步骤 1：检查当前状态
20	
21	```bash
22	entire status && entire checkpoint list && entire session current
23	```
24	
25	- 如果 `checkpoint list` 已经有记录 → 录制成功，跳到步骤 4 推送即可
26	- 如果 `session current` 显示 "No active session" → 继续步骤 2
27	
28	### 步骤 2：找到当前会话的转录文件
29	
30	```bash
31	ls -lt ~/.claude/projects/<项目路径slug>/*.jsonl | head -5
32	```
33	
34	项目路径 slug 可以在 `~/.claude/projects/` 目录下找对应的那个（通常是把路径中的特殊字符替换后的一串）。
35	
36	找到最新的 `.jsonl` 文件，取文件名（不含 `.jsonl` 后缀）作为 `SESSION_ID`。
37	
38	例如：`2c2bbb60-d26e-44d9-8169-c93fa31ca68a.jsonl` → SESSION_ID = `2c2bbb60-d26e-44d9-8169-c93fa31ca68a`
39	
40	### 步骤 3：手动附加会话
41	
42	```bash
43	entire session attach <SESSION_ID> --agent claude-code --force
44	```
45	
46	- `--agent claude-code`：告诉 Entire 这是 Claude Code 的对话
47	- `--force`：跳过确认，自动 amend 最近一次 commit 添加 `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer
48	
49	如果报 "failed to locate transcript"：
50	- 检查是否在项目根目录下运行
51	- 确认 SESSION_ID 对应的 `.jsonl` 文件确实存在
52	
53	### 步骤 4：推送 checkpoint 到远程
54	
55	```bash
56	git push origin main --force-with-lease
57	```
58	
59	`--force-with-lease` 是因为步骤 3 amend 了上一个 commit（添加了 checkpoint trailer）。推送时 Entire 会自动同步 `entire/checkpoints/` ref。
60	
61	### 步骤 5：验证
62	
63	```bash
64	entire checkpoint list
65	```
66	
67	应该能看到新创建的 checkpoint。然后访问 https://entire.io 确认网页上也能看到对话记录。
68	
69	---
70	
71	## 常见问题
72	
73	| 问题 | 解决 |
74	|------|------|
75	| `entire session attach` 报 "failed to locate transcript" | 确保在项目根目录运行；检查 SESSION_ID 是否拼写正确 |
76	| 网页上看不到 checkpoint | 等待 1-2 分钟索引；确认 `entire/checkpoints/v1` ref 已推送到 GitHub |
77	| hooks 完全不工作 | `entire agent remove claude-code && entire agent add claude-code` 重装 |
78	| checkpoint 跑到了其他仓库 | `entire activity` 查看全部仓库的记录，可能旧项目有残留 hooks |

1	# Entire.io 配置与使用指南
2	
3	为新仓库配置 Entire.io，实现 Claude Code 对话的自动录制和同步。
4	
5	> **两阶段流程**：本 skill 只负责**初始化配置**。配置完成后关掉窗口重开，在新会话中用 `/entire-attach` 确保录制成功并推送。
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 适用场景
10	
11	- 开始做作业或项目，希望自动记录所有 AI 对话
12	- 新克隆/新建的仓库还没有 Entire 录制
13	
14	---
15	
16	## 配置流程
17	
18	### 步骤 1：检查 Entire CLI 是否可用
19	
20	```bash
21	entire --version && entire auth status
22	```
23	
24	如果未安装，参考 https://docs.entire.io/cli/installation
25	
26	如果未登录：
27	```bash
28	entire login
29	# 浏览器中选择 GitHub 登录
30	```
31	
32	### 步骤 2：在仓库中启用 Entire
33	
34	在项目根目录下：
35	
36	```bash
37	entire enable
38	entire agent add claude-code
39	```
40	
41	执行后 `.claude/settings.json` 会被写入 hooks，`.entire/` 目录会被创建。
42	
43	### 步骤 3：检查仓库是否需要创建镜像
44	
45	```bash
46	MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 entire repo mirror list --show-available --json
47	```
48	
49	**Windows 注意**：Git Bash 下必须加 `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1`，否则路径会被自动转换导致报错。
50	
51	如果输出中目标仓库的 `status` 是 `"available"`，说明需要创建镜像：
52	
53	```bash
54	MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 entire repo mirror create github.com/<用户名>/<仓库名>
55	```
56	
57	如果 `status` 已经是 `"ready"`，说明镜像已存在，跳过此步。
58	
59	### 步骤 4：验证
60	
61	```bash
62	entire status
63	```
64	
65	应该显示 `Enabled` 和 `Claude Code` agent。
66	
67	### 步骤 5：关闭当前窗口，重开
68	
69	配置完成后，**立即关闭这个 Claude Code 窗口**，然后在仓库目录下新开一个窗口开始做作业。
70	
71	> **原因**：SessionStart hook 只在新会话启动时触发。当前会话在 hooks 写入之前就已经开始了，不会被录制。
72	
73	> **下一步**：在新窗口中完成作业后，使用 `/entire-attach` 检查并上传录制结果。
74	
75	---
76	
77	## 常见问题
78	
79	| 问题 | 解决 |
80	|------|------|
81	| `entire api` 报路径错误 | Git Bash 下加 `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` |
82	| 网页上看不到仓库 | 检查步骤 3 是否创建了镜像 |
83	| 网页显示 "hidden by filters" | 调整页面筛选器设置 |
84	| 仓库不在 `--show-available` 列表中 | 需要仓库在你的 GitHub 账号下有 admin 权限 |

> ## Documentation Index
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.entire.io/llms.txt
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

# Installation

> Install the Entire CLI on your system

## System Requirements

* **Operating System:** macOS, Linux, Windows
* **Git:** Version 2.25 or later
* **Shell:** Bash or Zsh (for hook installation)

## Installation Methods

Entire currently ships two release channels:

* `stable`: recommended for most users. This is the default channel for Homebrew, Scoop, and `install.sh`.
* `nightly`: prerelease builds for users who want the latest changes earlier.

Entire uses Homebrew casks so the CLI can be installed from the same signed release artifacts used by other install methods.

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="macOS (Homebrew)">
    The easiest way to install on macOS is via Homebrew.

    First, tap and trust the Entire tap. This is a one-time setup:

    ```bash theme={null}
    brew tap entireio/tap
    brew trust entireio/tap
    ```

    <Note>
      Homebrew 5.2.0 and 6.0.0 and later require trusting a third-party tap with `brew trust` before installing its casks. See [Tap Trust](https://docs.brew.sh/Tap-Trust).
    </Note>

    Then install the stable channel:

    ```bash theme={null}
    brew install --cask entire
    ```

    Or install the nightly channel:

    ```bash theme={null}
    brew install --cask entire@nightly
    ```

    To upgrade the stable channel:

    ```bash theme={null}
    brew upgrade --cask entire
    ```

    To upgrade the nightly channel:

    ```bash theme={null}
    brew upgrade --cask entire@nightly
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab title="Linux">
    Use the install script for Linux.

    Stable is the default:

    ```bash theme={null}
    curl -fsSL https://entire.io/install.sh | bash
    ```

    To install the nightly channel:

    ```bash theme={null}
    curl -fsSL https://entire.io/install.sh | bash -s -- --channel nightly
    ```

    Or download the binary directly:

    ```bash theme={null}
    # Download the latest release
    curl -LO https://github.com/entireio/cli/releases/latest/download/entire-linux-amd64.tar.gz

    # Extract and install
    tar -xzf entire-linux-amd64.tar.gz
    sudo mv entire /usr/local/bin/
    ```

    For ARM64 systems:

    ```bash theme={null}
    curl -LO https://github.com/entireio/cli/releases/latest/download/entire-linux-arm64.tar.gz
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab title="Windows (Scoop)">
    Scoop currently supports the stable channel only:

    ```bash theme={null}
    scoop bucket add entire https://github.com/entireio/scoop-bucket.git
    scoop install entire/cli
    ```

    To update:

    ```bash theme={null}
    scoop update entire/cli
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab title="From Source">
    If you have Go 1.21+ installed, you can build from source:

    ```bash theme={null}
    go install github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire@latest
    ```

    Or clone and build manually:

    ```bash theme={null}
    git clone https://github.com/entireio/cli.git
    cd cli
    go build -o entire ./cmd/entire
    sudo mv entire /usr/local/bin/
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Verify Installation

After installation, verify that Entire is working:

```bash theme={null}
entire version
```

You should see output like:

```
entire version 1.0.0 (abc1234)
```

The `entire` binary needs to be on your `$PATH` for agent hooks and Git hooks to work.

## Shell Completion

Entire supports shell completion for Bash and Zsh.

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Bash">
    Add to your `~/.bashrc`:

    ```bash theme={null}
    source <(entire completion bash)
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab title="Zsh">
    Add to your `~/.zshrc`:

    ```bash theme={null}
    source <(entire completion zsh)
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Uninstalling

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Homebrew">
    ```bash theme={null}
    brew uninstall --cask entire
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab title="Manual">
    ```bash theme={null}
    sudo rm /usr/local/bin/entire
    ```

    Also remove any configuration:

    ```bash theme={null}
    rm -rf ~/.config/entire
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>
